run_VisualizationDemo_on_image: run a VisualizationDemo on a BGR image to get panoptic or instance segmentation predictions and visualized output
run_VisualizationDemo_on_video: run a VisualizationDemo on a video stream to yield visualized BGR frames with segmentation predictions
create_AsyncPredictor: create an AsyncPredictor with multiple GPU workers to run model predictions asynchronously across processes
use_AsyncPredictor_call: use an AsyncPredictor as a callable to submit an image and receive ordered prediction results
review_AsyncPredictor_put_get: review the AsyncPredictor put and get methods for async task queuing and ordered result retrieval
